name: Distribution Families for Differentiable Rendering
definition: PDFs $f$ are defined as the derivative of the CDF $F$. A reversed CDF is defined as $F_{\text{Rev.}}(x) = 1 - F(-x)$. The square-root distribution $F_{\text{sq}}$ is defined in terms of $F$ as in Equation (5) of the full paper.
summary: Distribution Families for Differentiable Rendering provide a unified library of smooth, parameterized CDFs and PDFs to replace hard classification with continuous curves, enabling gradient flow through opacity and color assignment during backpropagation.
